newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard gets conditional Nasdaq listing.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard gets conditional Nasdaq listing.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said the Nasdaq Stock Market had granted it conditional listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
The company said in a statement late on Thursday the market also had given it an extension until September 11 to satisfy net worth requirements for continued listing on the market.
Starting on Friday the trading symbol for the securities changed from VNGD to VNGDC. Upon satisfying the requirements, the "C" will be removed from the company's symbol.

If the company does not satisfy the requirements before September 11, 1996, the common shares of Vanguard Airlines would no longer be eligible for listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market and would be listed on the OTC Bulletin Board.
The company also said it completed a $5.2 million private placement of units of securities, each unit consisting of common stock, par value $.001, and a redeemable common stock purchase warrant.
The company estimated it had raised about 70 percent of the equity financing required to satisfy the Nasdaq net worth requirement.
